description: Central Tool Registry for DeveloperOS Open-Source Tools Ecosystem (https://developeros.in)

suites.name: Web & Frontend Craft Suite
suites.description: Essential web development utilities: CSS generators, meta-tag builders, HTML sanitizers, SVG encoders.

suites.name: API & Network Suite
suites.description: HTTP request builders, cURL converters, JWT decoders, webhook debuggers, and status code references.

suites.name: Cryptography & Security Suite
suites.description: Secure hashing algorithms, HMAC signatures, UUID/ULID generation, SSL certificate inspection, secret masking.

suites.name: Data Conversion & Serialization Suite
suites.description: Bidirectional converters for JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, CSV, diff inspectors, and jq filters.

suites.name: Cloud & DevOps Configuration Suite
suites.description: Dockerfile linters, Kubernetes manifest validators, cron expression humanizers, CIDR range calculators.

suites.name: Code Refactoring & Syntax Suite
suites.description: Regex testers, AST inspectors, code minifiers, prettifiers, snippet generators across multiple languages.

suites.name: Database & SQL Utilities Suite
suites.description: SQL query formatters, mock schema builders, synthetic tabular data generators, query plan visualizers.

suites.name: Media & Asset Processing Suite
suites.description: Base64 image encoders, SVG optimizers, color palette extractors, aspect ratio calculators.

suites.name: Documentation & Specifications Suite
suites.description: Markdown previewers, OpenAPI 3.0 visualizers, changelog generators, README builders.

suites.name: Performance & Benchmark Suite
suites.description: Payload size calculators, regex execution benchmarks, network latency estimators, load test script generators.

tools.name: OpenGraph & Meta Tag Generator
tools.description: Generate and preview valid HTML meta tags, OpenGraph cards, and Twitter Cards.

tools.name: CSS Glassmorphism & Shadow Builder
tools.description: Interactive generator for modern CSS backdrop-filter, gradients, and box-shadows.

tools.name: cURL Command to Code Converter
tools.description: Parse raw cURL commands into clean Python (requests/httpx) and JavaScript (fetch) code.

tools.name: Client-Side JWT Inspector
tools.description: Decode and validate JSON Web Token headers, claims, and expiration timestamps without server transmission.

tools.name: Multi-Algorithm Hash Generator
tools.description: Compute SHA-256, SHA-512, MD5, and Blake2 hashes from text strings or files.

tools.name: UUID / ULID Cryptographic Generator
tools.description: Batch generate UUIDv4, UUIDv7, and ULID identifiers with collision checking.

tools.name: JSON <-> YAML <-> TOML Converter
tools.description: Convert, format, and validate structured data between JSON, YAML, and TOML schemas.

tools.name: CSV to JSON / JSON to CSV Transformer
tools.description: Bi-directional tabular transformation with automatic delimiter detection and type inference.

tools.name: Cron Expression Explainer & Schedule Calculator
tools.description: Translate complex crontab schedules into human language and forecast upcoming execution timestamps.

tools.name: IP & CIDR Subnet Calculator
tools.description: Calculate network ranges, broadcast addresses, subnet masks, and usable host counts for IPv4/IPv6.

tools.name: Regular Expression Tester & Match Explainer
tools.description: Test regex patterns with visual match group highlighting and ReDoS protection.

tools.name: Python AST Tree Visualizer
tools.description: Inspect Abstract Syntax Trees of Python code for linting, security analysis, and static inspection.

tools.name: SQL Query Formatter & Minifier
tools.description: Format and beautify complex SQL queries across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and Snowflake dialects.

tools.name: Relational Mock Data Generator
tools.description: Generate synthetic SQL INSERT statements with foreign key consistency and faker data.

tools.name: Base64 Image & Data URI Encoder/Decoder
tools.description: Convert PNG, JPEG, SVG, WebP images to ready-to-use CSS data URIs and vice versa.

tools.name: SVG Optimizer & Path Cleaner
tools.description: Clean, sanitize, and minify SVG markup removing editor metadata and redundant attributes.

tools.name: Markdown Editor & Realtime GitHub Previewer
tools.description: Full-featured Markdown and GFM live previewer with table generator and math formula support.

tools.name: OpenAPI / Swagger Spec Validator
tools.description: Validate OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 YAML/JSON specs and preview interactive documentation endpoints.

tools.name: API Payload Size & Compression Estimator
tools.description: Analyze raw payload sizes and estimate Gzip, Brotli, and Zstandard compressed transfer sizes.

tools.name: Global Network Latency Calculator
tools.description: Estimate theoretical RTT and packet transfer times across global cloud regions and undersea cables.
